rationale: The stock gapped down ~2.8% at open and has been trading in a narrow, low-conviction range over the last five 1-minute candles with no clear directional momentum — price oscillates between $58.01 and $58.40 on mixed volume. The wide bid-ask spread of 60 bps relative to the ATR of ~$0.56 makes the cost of entry unfavorable, as the spread alone consumes a meaningful portion of any expected move. With SPY down 2.25% and VIXY elevated, the macro environment is risk-off but the stock has already absorbed much of its gap, leaving no clean technical setup with a favorable risk/reward in either direction.
